There is thick fog on the road.
Tomorrow it will be|In a storm, we should|My favourite weather is

text_en: Last October, a big typhoon hit the coast near Minh's town.
The weather forecast on TV told everyone to prepare.
Minh's family shut all the windows and put their bikes in the garage.
They had torches, candles, water and food.
That night, the wind was very strong, and it rained heavily.
There was a power cut, so they used torches.
The next morning, the storm was over.
The wind broke some branches, and there were big puddles in the streets.
Everyone in Minh's family was safe.

questions.q: Why did the family use torches?
What was in the streets the next morning?
